reviews.text: How convenient, this was purchased in error by my minor niece and I want a refund so I tap the contact us link on ur app and it won’t open. reviews.title: Use Something Else
reviews.text: There are just way better apps. I wanted to try out the subscription so I clicked on the 0.67 a week option and they charged me 30$ for a year. All of the customer service links in the app are broken. You can’t get all of the app icons in themes; you can only choose certain app links. If you choose a theme, they make you web links for the app instead of a bookmark or new picture, so when you click on the app, it takes you to a web page real quick and then to the app. I guess if you want to make your own theme, you could use this app, but there are better apps for that. Just get themify or make your own.

reviews.title: Good app, lots of glitches
reviews.text: i’ve been using brass for a few years now and have always thought it was the best app for widgets. however i’ve had to completely switch over from brass due to a glitch within the app saying I have a VPN configuration blocking my internet traffic. i don’t have a VPN downloaded at all, i tried every possible thing i could do to try to get the app to work again but nothing has worked. i even deleted the app and redownloaded it but it still won’t work. i tried to contact the app support team however when you click on the link to take you there, there is a just a picture of a phone and no contact information or anything. I’m pretty sad about this because like i said this is the only app i’ve used for widgets for YEARS. The app will often just not load at all for 1-2 days at a time but i’ve never had it last for more than 2 days. Unfortunately all of my widgets are gone now and i can’t even get them back. Save your time and use a different app….
